# Synthetic fixtures

ISO-BMFF/QuickTime container bytes and filesystem trees built from scratch
in test code (or by a small script committed alongside its tests) — never
derived from a real sample's actual bytes. Placeholder text such as
`"sample transcript text"` stands in for transcript content, per
`AGENTS.md`'s local-sample handling rules.

Phase 4 (native transcript extraction) is expected to populate this
directory once the atom-parsing code exists to exercise it against.
